purpose: Record the exact public legacy Neurosetta PCA/eigen-alignment code available before the December 2025 Point_data.pkl artifact, without claiming it is the historical producer.

coord_eig_decomp.signature: coord_eig_decomp(coords, robust=True, center=False, PCA=True, sort=True, transpose=True)
coord_eig_decomp.sorting: If sort=True, eigenvalues sorted descending and eigenvector columns reordered accordingly
coord_eig_decomp.normalization: PCA=True divides eigenvalues by their sum

eig_align.signature: eig_align(N, eig_order, align_order, perspective_order, center='root', robust=True, bind=True)
capabilities: Caller supplies an eigenvector index for each of three sequential alignments via eig_order
Caller independently supplies destination axes via align_order
Caller independently supplies rotation/perspective axes via perspective_order
center can be root, mean, median or None for supported input forms
coord_eig_decomp is invoked with the selected robust flag
eig_align.mechanism: align_eigen_single computes a minimum angle for a selected eigenvector then rotates coordinates and eigenvectors about a supplied perspective axis
eig_align.output_behavior: With bind=True, writes rotated coordinates to a Neurosetta graph; with bind=False, returns rotated coordinates. It does not define the historical Subtype_evDir_x/y/z DataFrame columns.

legacy_source_serialization_gap: The public legacy function exposes an axis/eigenvector-order mechanism, but its declared environment does not list JAX directly.
The inspected eig_align function returns or binds rotated coordinates, not a scalar direction-vector DataFrame.
The historic pickle's 46,624 scalar cells across eight columns use jaxlib._jax.ArrayImpl; the public legacy snapshot alone does not explain this serialization signature.

proven: Public legacy Neurosetta source from 2025-01-15 had robust covariance PCA/eigendecomposition and configurable eigenvector/destination/perspective-axis ordering before the December 2025 artifact.
The implementation uses NumPy/SciPy/scikit-learn and does not itself create the exact historical Subtype_evDir fields.
This is a separate public pre-artifact axis-selection mechanism alongside the JAX-based GeoJax family.
not_proven: That the producer of Point_data.pkl called eig_align or coord_eig_decomp.
That the producer imported this legacy repository at this exact commit.
That the exact axis/eigenvector order or robust setting used for any T4/T5 subtype can be recovered from this code alone.
That JAX was absent from the author's actual runtime; the observation is limited to the committed environment.yml not declaring it directly.
